## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass, or this change does not affect the backend
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass, or this change does not affect the UI
- [ ] Migration behavior was tested for database changes
- [ ] Tenant isolation was tested for user-owned data
- [ ] Examples and logs contain no real credentials, network details, or personal data
- [ ] Physical hardware checks are listed separately from compilation

## Deployment and compatibility

Call out migrations, environment variables, rollback constraints, API changes, and
hardware or integration compatibility. Write `None` when there is no impact.
